body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzj9DrVWXkq7joYHGB

Post-release smoke of the PUBLISHED 18.5.0 (npm), real user paths, under checklist-test §6. Asked by the maintainer, 2026-11-15 13:26Z, verbatim: 「18.5 已发布」. Shape copied from the 18.4.0 record #33105 (cells A–F, versions bumped). Wave anchor #33761.

## ENVIRONMENT

- **Subject:** `@objectstack/*@18.5.0` and `create-objectstack@18.5.0`, from npm.
  - dist-tag latest = next = 18.5.0. Published 2026-11-15T13:02:20.072Z per `npm view @objectstack/spec time`; 18.4.0 was 2026-11-13T12:30:15.590Z.
  - Release commit `b914e7247f692a79804f9b7eba278add46d57625` (tag `@objectstack/spec@18.5.0`).
  - Everything under test was installed from the registry into /tmp/smoke185, outside the repo. No workspace build and no `link:`.
- **Source checkout:** used only to read docs, at the release commit (`git show b914e724:PATH`). main was read at `45dee177b` for the re-judge.
- **Tools:**
  - Node v22.23.4, npm 10.9.9, pnpm 10.28.0 in the scaffolds (the scaffolder's pick).
  - PostgreSQL 16.15, a local cluster on port 41119.
  - Chromium through Playwright.
- **Ports:** 41100–41103 (dev, production start, pg app) and 41120–41124 (upgrade, probe scaffold). One file DB per cell.
- **Run:** 2026-11-15 13:28–13:47 UTC. Two runner agents in parallel, S1 (A, B, C, E) and S2 (D, F), each sequential within its cells.

## A. NEW USER ONBOARDING (docs at b914e724: getting-started/your-first-project.mdx, unchanged since 181ad7d4)
A1 PASS. npm create objectstack@18.5.0 my-app -- --skip-skills: exit 0, 9 s, banner "Create ObjectStack v18.5.0", installed with pnpm (26 template files). All 9 @objectstack pins in package.json are exactly 18.5.0 (spec, runtime, plugin-hono-server, connector-rest/-openapi/-mcp; dev: cli, skills, verify); cli, spec, runtime resolve 18.5.0 in node_modules and console resolves @objectstack+console@18.5.0. pnpm-lock.yaml packages section: 60 @objectstack entries, all 18.5.0 (18.4.0: 59). No .claude dir written.
A2 PASS. npx -y create-objectstack@18.5.0 skillapp (skills on): exit 0, 10 s, "Installing AI skills ... from @objectstack/skills@18.5.0", "Found 11 skills". 11 skills in .claude/skills, names and content identical (diff -rq) to node_modules/@objectstack/skills@18.5.0 dist/skills; only the catalog README.md is not copied.
A3 PASS. npx os validate (my-app): exit 0, 68 author-time rules (18.4.0: 65), 1 object, 2 fields, 1 app, 1 view, 3 plugins; "Validation passed (145ms)".
A4 PASS. npx os dev --ui -p 41100: compiles dist/objectstack.json (3.2 KB), "Server is ready" in about 12 s, Driver SqlDriver(better-sqlite3) on .objectstack/data/objectstack.db, 43 plugins including ConsoleUI, dev admin admin@objectos.ai / admin123 seeded. 0 WARN/ERROR lines on boot. GET /api/v1/discovery 200.
A5 PASS. GET /_console/ 200 text/html, 24195 bytes. Entry chunk assets/index-DPeAgiy5.js 200 application/javascript, 391760 bytes, byte-identical (cmp; sha256 b1ab01ff…8a610c8d both sides) to the published @objectstack/console@18.5.0 dist (npm pack into /tmp/smoke185/s1/consolepkg). The served index.html differs from dist/index.html only by the server-injected description/og/robots meta tags, the base href, the title and the nonce'd capabilities/inline scripts. (Entry chunk 475017 → 391760 bytes vs 18.4.0.)
A6 PASS. Real browser (Playwright chromium, two fresh contexts): /_console/ goes to /_console/login (1.6 s and 1.2 s to network idle); signing in as the dev admin through the form lands on /_console/home ("Get your system ready" checklist 1 of 6 done incl. Default currency, then "Good afternoon, Dev Admin."; Your apps 1: Main). After sign-in: 0 console errors, 0 responses >= 400, both runs. Before sign-in: the anonymous GET /api/v1/auth/get-session 401 only (same as 18.4.0, observation).
A7 PASS. The docs' CRUD (section 4) on :41100: sign-in 200; POST /api/v1/data/my_app_note 201 (record with organization_id, owner_id); GET ?select=title&sort=-created_at&top=10 200 (total 1, records [{title}]); GET by id 200; PATCH 200; DELETE 200 success true (recycleBinEntryId returned); GET 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND. Anonymous GET 401 UNAUTHENTICATED. POST /api/v1/auth/sign-up/email 403 SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED ("audience posture invite_only").
A8 PASS. Record created through the Console UI at /_console/apps/com.example.my-app/my_app_note (starter app Main, Notes / All Notes): New opens the "Create Note" dialog, fill Title, Create gives POST /api/v1/data/my_app_note 201, toast 'Note "Created in Console UI 18.5" created', the record panel opens (?recordId=8ro-m45EzsoC8Nxd) with Activity 1 ("Created Note …", Dev Admin); server read-back GET /api/v1/data/my_app_note/8ro-m45EzsoC8Nxd 200 with that title. 0 console errors, 0 responses >= 400 after sign-in. No currency prompt over the page (currency sits in the Home checklist, as in 18.4.0).

## B. STUDIO (same dev boot, :41100)
B1 PASS. /_console/studio loads the App Builder (1.75 s to network idle): "My packages (writable)" section (empty, "New package (writable base)"), Organization flows, Environment catalog, and the scaffold's My App (com.example.my-app) as Installed read-only ("0 customized, 0 switched off"). Opening My App goes to /_console/studio/com.example.my-app/data?surface=object:my_app_note and shows the Note object (2 fields +8 system, Read-only banner) and the record created in A8 ("Created in Console UI 18.5", owner Dev Admin, 1 record). 0 console errors, 0 responses >= 400.
B2 PASS. Authoring loop in a real browser: New package "Smoke Tracker" (only Display name filled; POST /api/v1/packages 201, lands on /_console/studio/com.default.smoke-tracker/data, "No drafts pending publish") → New object "Ticket" (identifier auto-filled as ticket; the dialog now also carries a "Record sharing (OWD)" picker defaulting to "Private — owner only"; "Save as draft": PUT /api/v1/meta/object/smoke_tracker_ticket?mode=draft&package=com.default.smoke-tracker&surface=studio 200, "Draft · 1 unpublished", 1 field Name +8 system, "Changes · 1") → Publish → "Pending changes" dialog (1 item · 1 object, Ticket New, includes + Name) → Publish all (POST /api/v1/packages/com.default.smoke-tracker/publish-drafts 200), toast "Published 1 item in this package / Members can use it once a permission set grants them access. / Open Access" → reload shows "No drafts pending publish" and the live Records grid. REST on the new object as the dev admin: POST /api/v1/data/smoke_tracker_ticket 201 (twice), list 200 total 2 (T-1, T-2); anonymous list 401. 0 console errors and 0 responses >= 400 across the loop.

## C. PRODUCTION DEPLOY PATH (A1's scaffold, OS_AUTH_SECRET and OS_SECRET_KEY set, fresh SQLite file /tmp/smoke185/s1/cdb/prod.db)
C1 PASS. os build exit 0 (dist/objectstack.json 3298 B / 3.2 KB); OS_DATABASE_URL=file:FRESH os migrate apply --yes exit 0 (94 tables created, 0 changes, 2 runtime-owned partial unique indexes; "birth marker written (shape generation 1, platform 18.5.0)"); os start --artifact ./dist/objectstack.json --port 41101: Mode production, health answering in about 8 s, 0 WARN/ERROR log lines on the start (one "⚠ StorageServicePlugin using local driver" console advisory, see observations); GET /api/v1/health 200 {"status":"ok","version":"18.5.0"}.
C2 PASS. First sign-up admitted (POST /api/v1/auth/sign-up/email 200, session token), the second 403 SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED (and that address then cannot sign in, 401); no dev admin in production (admin@objectos.ai sign-in 401 INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD).
C3 PASS. CRUD as the first admin: create 201, list 200 (total 1), get 200, patch 200, delete 200, get 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND; anonymous list 401. /_console/ 200 text/html; real-browser sign-in as the first admin lands on /_console/home ("Good afternoon, Owner.", app Main) with 0 console errors and 0 responses >= 400 after sign-in (anonymous get-session 401 before, as in dev). (A first browser attempt that typed the dev-admin credentials timed out on the login page: automation self-check, the script's hard-coded credentials, not the product; rerun with the owner's credentials passed.)

## E. POSTGRESQL (16.15 local cluster in /tmp/smoke185/s1/pg, port 41119; pgapp = a copy of A1's scaffold, dev port 41102)
E1 PASS. Before pg is installed: os dev -p 41102 -d postgres://…/smoke185 exits 1 with the remedy "The database client package `pg` is not installed, so no connection was attempted. It is an OPTIONAL install of @objectstack/driver-sql … `npm install pg` (pnpm add pg / yarn add pg) — then start again." Observation (not filed, unchanged from 18.3.0/18.4.0): the remedy is preceded by knex's raw "Cannot find module 'pg'" and a 6-line require stack, and starts with "connect failed — Knex: run $ npm install pg --save".
E2 PASS. After pnpm add pg (8.23.1): "Driver: SqlDriver(pg)", ready in about 17 s, 42 plugins (43 on SQLite), 0 WARN/ERROR at ready; sign-in 200; docs CRUD 201/200 (total 1)/200/200/200/404; /_console/ 200 text/html; real-browser sign-in lands on /_console/home with 0 console errors and 0 responses >= 400 after sign-in, and a record created through the Console UI (POST 201, toast 'Note "Created in Console UI on pg 18.5" created', record panel opens). Studio loop on pg (smoke185r1): New package 201, Save as draft PUT 200, Publish all → sys_metadata row state active.
E3 FAIL (product defect, NEW, sibling of #26630; pre-existing in 18.4.0, not a regression). #26630's own indexes hold: pg_indexes shows uniq_sys_setting_organization_id_namespace_key_scope_user_id over (organization_id, namespace, key, scope, COALESCE(user_id, '')) and uniq_sys_notification_preference_a22d7d27 over (organization_id, COALESCE(user_id, ''), topic, channel), same as #33105. But the 0-DATABASE_ERROR clause does not hold: every boot prints one `[sql-driver] DATABASE_ERROR — the backend refused a raw statement (2BP01) … cannot drop index idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active because constraint idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active on table sys_metadata requires it`. It is printed AFTER "Server is ready", on the process's first GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts (any Console home load makes it), so a count taken at ready reads 0 (a restart with only curl CRUD read 0 too). Measured on 3 fresh databases (smoke185, smoke185r1, smoke185r2) and 3 restarts over smoke185r1, 6 of 6 boots that served /api/v1/meta/_drafts; 0 on boots that did not. The index stays the declared fallback: pg_indexes idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active = UNIQUE (type, name, package_id, bundle_member) held by a UNIQUE CONSTRAINT (pg_constraint contype u), not the runtime partial form (type, name, COALESCE(package_id,''), COALESCE(bundle_member,'')) WHERE state='active' that SQLite carries (read from sqlite_master on A's dev DB). Consequence measured in rolled-back transactions: on pg, a second ACTIVE row for the published smoke_tracker_ticket (same type, name, package_id, NULL bundle_member) gives INSERT 0 1 (2 active rows), and two ACTIVE package-less rows for one (type, name) are both admitted; the same two inserts on SQLite are refused ("UNIQUE constraint failed: index 'idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active'"). No [metadata-protocol] degradation line is printed. Baseline: a create-objectstack@18.4.0 scaffold on a fresh pg database (smoke184, port 41103, health 18.4.0) prints the same line after a Console home load and leaves the same index, so #33105's E3 0-count missed it (count taken before the trigger, most likely). The 18.5.0 data of the restart cell itself survived: a record and the session cookie read back 200 after restart.


## D. UPGRADE 18.4.0 → 18.5.0 WITH REAL DATA (dir /tmp/smoke185/s2, ports 41120–41123)

D1 PASS. App from create-objectstack@18.4.0 (`npx -y create-objectstack@18.4.0 app184 --skip-skills`, exit 0, 19 s; 9 pins 18.4.0, 60 @objectstack lock entries all 18.4.0) on its default file DB (.objectstack/data/objectstack.db + the dev telemetry sibling objectstack.telemetry.db). To give 18.5.0's one named data step something to do, the app got one approval flow (record-after-insert on app184_note → one approval node routed to org_membership_level owner) and `requires` + 'approvals' (os validate exit 0) before any data was written. os dev on 18.4.0, port 41120, health 18.4.0. Written over HTTP on 18.4.0: dev admin sign-in 200; POST /api/v1/auth/admin/create-user 200 (upg.user@example.com, mustChangePassword true), that user signs in 200; POST /api/v1/data/app184_note 201 (f4WyDQs897Wfsp36), which opened a pending sys_approval_request carrying payload_json; PUT /api/settings/branding {workspace_name:"Smoke v18.4"} 200 (source tenant). The 18.5.0 datum, read raw from the telemetry sibling: 1 sys_audit_log copy (object sys_approval_request) and 1 sys_activity row whose copies hold payload_json (the side copy 18.5.0's `os migrate audit-side-copies` removes, cli CHANGELOG 4e1d327). Server stopped by process group, port and DB file free. Bumped all 9 @objectstack pins to 18.5.0; pnpm install exit 0 (only the usual 6 deprecated-subdependency WARN, no peer warning; 60 lock entries, all 18.5.0); `os --version` @objectstack/cli/18.5.0; os validate exit 0; os build exit 0. upgrading.mdx at b914e724 has no v18.5.0 row (see F1) but does name one 18.5.0 step in its Per-release section ("Upgrading from 18.4.0 or earlier: run os migrate audit-side-copies once, a dry run first and then --apply"). Run: generic loop os migrate meta --from 18 exit 0 (no step 18 → 18, as printed) and --from 17 exit 0 (the 18-5 page's command; lists the protocol-18 entries); os migrate plan exit 0 (8 tables to create — the telemetry-routed tables, see O-D2 — 3 safe index changes, 1 destructive); and every subcommand `npx os migrate --help` lists on 18.5.0, read-only/dry-run, before the 18.5.0 boot: account-issuer, activity-changed-fields, audit-key-material, audit-mail-bodies, audit-metadata-bodies, audit-side-copies, blank-multi-values, blank-single-values, comment-parent-pair, comment-reactions, duplicates, files-to-references, multi-value-columns, option-codes, organization-ownership, packageless-overlays, recorded-by, resume, security-catalog-overlays, stored-expressions, stored-references (and --dev), summary-nulls, text-scalars, unmapped-columns --object app184_note, value-shapes: all exit 0. recompute-home-amounts --object app184_note exit 1 (correct refusal: the object declares no home amount) and record-currency-codes exit 2 (oclif: --code/--field/--object required) — neither applies to this app. os dev 18.5.0 on the same file (port 41121): ready, health 18.5.0, 0 DATABASE_ERROR lines (one "[schema-drift] auto-reconciled replace_unique_index on sys_connector_connection.connector_package", the #31699 key widening the CHANGELOG names). Admin sign-in 200; the created user with its original password 200 (wrong password 401); the note reads back 200 with title and body; branding.workspace_name reads "Smoke v18.4" source tenant; the approval request is still pending; sys_audit_log as admin 200 serves the approval-request copy without payload_json (read-time redaction). After the boot: `os migrate audit-side-copies` bare → "0 of 0 … ✓ Nothing to remove" (see O-D1); with NODE_ENV=development → dry run "2 of 2" (sys_audit_log 1, sys_activity 1), --apply --yes exit 0 "removed … from 2 of 2", second --apply "0 of 2 … Nothing to remove" (idempotent); raw read: 0 copies hold payload_json afterwards. os migrate apply --yes exit 0 (8 tables created, 0 safe left — the dev boot had auto-applied them — 1 destructive skipped); second plan: 0 tables, 0 safe, 0 needs-confirm, 1 destructive: drop_index sys_approval_action.idx_sys_approval_action_actor_id (orphaned: 18.5.0's plugin-approvals declares (actor_id, organization_id) and (acted_as, organization_id) instead; see O-D3). apply --allow-destructive exit 0 (1 applied), third plan "Physical schema is in sync with metadata — nothing to migrate". A further 18.5.0 boot after the applies: user 200, admin 200, note 200, setting "Smoke v18.4", 0 DATABASE_ERROR.

D2 PASS (the same upgrade on the untouched default scaffold, as #33105 D1 ran it). create-objectstack@18.4.0 app184b, no edits; os dev 18.4.0 (41122, health 18.4.0): create-user 200, its sign-in 200, note 201, PUT branding "Smoke v18.4 B" 200. Stopped; pins → 18.5.0, pnpm install exit 0 (60 entries all 18.5.0), validate 0, build 0, meta --from 18 exit 0, plan exit 0 (8 tables, 1 safe uniq_sys_connector_connection_418b410f, 0 destructive), audit-side-copies dry run 0 of 0 bare and with NODE_ENV=development (no approvals composed, nothing to remove). os dev 18.5.0 (41123): health 18.5.0, 0 DATABASE_ERROR, admin 200, the user with its original password 200, note title reads back, setting "Smoke v18.4 B" tenant. os migrate apply --yes exit 0 (8 tables, 0 changes), second plan "in sync — nothing to migrate" bare and with NODE_ENV=development: 0 changes.

D OBSERVATIONS
- O-D1. On a dev project (os dev keeps audit copies in the telemetry sibling), the documented `os migrate audit-side-copies` (no flags) boots as a production serve, reads only objectstack.db, and prints "2 object(s) have no table in this database yet … ✓ Nothing to remove — no audit/activity copy holds a side-copy column" while 2 copies in objectstack.telemetry.db hold payload_json; NODE_ENV=development finds and removes them. Same composition rule as #22579's fix (documented for plan/apply in cli.mdx, "without NODE_ENV=development describes a production os serve"), but neither the upgrading.mdx 18.5.0 line, the 18-5 checklist step nor the command's own cli.mdx section says it, and the command has no --dev flag (stored-references has one). Read-time redaction still drops the column, so not a leak; the "Nothing to remove" all-clear is the misleading part. Production (no OS_TELEMETRY_DB) keeps sys_audit_log on the primary, where the bare command is right. Dedupe: `audit-side-copies` (#33155 closed, the door itself), `telemetry migrate dev` (#22579 closed, plan/apply), `audit-key-material telemetry`, `"telemetry sibling"`, `"nothing to remove" audit` — no card for the one-shot data commands' dev reading. Same applies by construction to audit-key-material / audit-mail-bodies / audit-metadata-bodies / activity-changed-fields.
- O-D2. Bare `os migrate plan` / `apply` on a dev file DB still plans and creates the 8 telemetry-routed tables empty in the primary (unchanged from 18.4.0 O3; documented #22579 behaviour).
- O-D3. An 18.4.0 app that composes approvals keeps the old idx_sys_approval_action_actor_id after the upgrade; 18.5.0's plan lists its drop as destructive until `os migrate apply --allow-destructive`. Harmless (an extra index), the plan is accurate, but no 18.5.0 note tells the operator to expect it; the default scaffold (D2) does not have it.


## F. RE-JUDGE AND PROBES

F1a PASS (#33105 D2 / card #33106 re-judged, on the docs a reader gets). At origin/main 45dee177b: upgrading.mdx "Per-release specifics" has the row `v18.5.0 | Upgrade checklist — 18.5.0 → /docs/releases/v18/18-5#upgrade-checklist` (line 468), and content/docs/releases/v18/18-5.mdx exists (748 lines, "## Upgrade checklist" → "### 18.5.0" with steps 1–4). Both landed in c87e2ad2c (docs(releases): 18.5.0 release notes, the v18 line overview and its upgrading row, #33823; card #33798 closed), committed 2026-11-15T12:14Z — 48 min BEFORE the npm publish (13:02Z), the first release of the last four where the page exists when the packages do. At the release commit b914e724 itself (11:34Z) there is still no v18.5.0 row (newest v18.4.0) and no 18-5.mdx (18-0…18-4 + index), while releases/index.mdx at b914e724 line 22 already says "current series: 18.5.0, released 2026-11-15" — the tag names a page it does not carry (see O-F1). The 18.4.0 row and 18-4.mdx (the #33105 D2 subject) are present at both b914e724 and 45dee177b; #33106 closed completed 2026-11-13T22:32Z.

F1b FAIL (release notes / docs, not release-blocking). BREAKING reachability. `git log --oneline 181ad7d4..b914e724 | grep -c '!:'` = 63, not 59 (all 63 are conventional `type(scope)!:` subjects; same count with --no-merges and --first-parent). From upgrading.mdx at b914e724: 0 of 63 reachable through a row (no v18.5.0 row); the page names one 18.5.0 step only ("Upgrading from 18.4.0 or earlier: os migrate audit-side-copies"). From upgrading.mdx at main → 18-5.mdx: 62 of 63 cited on the page by commit sha (e.g. org-scoped seed 47a3b95ec #33222 at lines 345 and 745, "Check seed hooks under a walled posture … ctx.api.sudo()"). The one not reachable: ac0b9a5f9 `fix(plugin-audit)!: seal a window into checkpoints of at most 10,000 rows …` (#33637, merged 10:51Z, an ancestor of b914e724), declared "Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — os audit verify reports a row id that two checkpoints list as the new chain fault listed_twice and fails the run, where the 18.4.0 verifier accepted it". The published @objectstack/plugin-audit@18.5.0 ships it (`listed_twice` in dist/index.js, .mjs, .d.mts) but its CHANGELOG.md has 0 hits and 18-5.mdx has none (no listed_twice / checkpoint / #33637 / #31908); its changeset `.changeset/31908-p4b2-bounded-checkpoints.md` is still pending at the tag. It is one of 11 changesets still in .changeset/ at b914e724 whose commits (10:36–11:18Z) are in the tagged code: 31908-p4b2-bounded-checkpoints, 33186-managed-add-people-actions, 33609-related-list-parent-lookup-page, 33649-messaging-preferences-emitting-organization, 33660-ai-model-picker-cost-multiplier, 33689-ai-action-confirmation-elicited (the second `!`, 1e65a389e; the 18-5 page does cover it as "Announced, not yet at any door", but spec@18.5.0's CHANGELOG has 0 "elicit" hits), 33724-install-relaxes-declared-not-null, 33739/33753/33754 (scenarios), a2-skills-docs-32678-32825. Same class as #29957 (18.3.0: a shipped narrowing with no CHANGELOG line because the Version Packages PR was merged without regenerating).
  Repro: (1) `git show b914e724:.changeset/31908-p4b2-bounded-checkpoints.md` → exists, `fix(plugin-audit)!: … os audit verify fails on a row two checkpoints list`; `git merge-base --is-ancestor ac0b9a5f9 b914e724` → true. (2) `npm pack @objectstack/plugin-audit@18.5.0`, `grep -l listed_twice package/dist/*` → 3 files; `grep -c listed_twice package/CHANGELOG.md` → 0. (3) `git show 45dee177b:content/docs/releases/v18/18-5.mdx | grep -c -E 'listed_twice|ac0b9a5|33637'` → 0. Expected: every `!` change in the published 18.5.0 packages is named in the 18.5.0 CHANGELOG and reachable from the 18-5 page. Actual: one shipped narrowing (`os audit verify` now fails on a chain 18.4.0 accepted) is named nowhere in 18.5.0's notes; ten more shipped changes are likewise missing from the 18.5.0 CHANGELOGs.
  Disposition: release-process / docs defect, recurrence of #29957 (closed completed). Dedupe (open+closed): `listed_twice` (#33773 skills follow-up, #31908 epic — neither is about the 18.5.0 notes), `31908-p4b2`, `version packages changeset not consumed` (#29957 closed, #25638 closed, #29933 closed), `changesets pending at the release commit`, `18.5.0 release page` (#33798 closed = the page itself). No card for 18.5.0. Card draft text: see CARD-DRAFT F1b below.

- O-F1. Tag lag: b914e724 (the npm tag) carries no 18-5.mdx and no row while its releases/index.mdx names 18.5.0 as current; the notes landed on main 40 min after the tag and before the publish. A reader of the source at the tag sees the 18.4.0 shape again. Known ordering (#33798), recorded, not filed.

F2 PASS. On a fresh 18.5.0 scaffold (`npx -y create-objectstack@18.5.0 probe185 --skip-skills` exit 0; 9 pins exactly 18.5.0, 60 lock entries all 18.5.0): `npx os doctor` exit 0, "✅ Environment is healthy and ready for development!", 0 ⚠ / ✗ lines (Node v22.23.4, pnpm 10.28.0, TypeScript 5.9.3, platform protocol covered, no circular deps, all objects referenced, views valid; test-coverage and deprecations skipped as monorepo-only). Bare `npx os` prints the help with VERSION @objectstack/cli/18.5.0 linux-x64 node-v22.23.4.

F3 PASS (#33250 headline, PR #33369 df9fe94). Own 18.5.0 scaffold probe185 (F2's), os dev port 41124, health 18.5.0, 0 DATABASE_ERROR. Authored from rls.mdx / sharing-rules.mdx / error-catalog.mdx at b914e724: master probe185_order (sharingModel public_read: every member reads, only the owner edits), master probe185_vault (private), detail probe185_line (controlled_by_parent, master_detail order required, `sharing: { controlledByParent: { writeRequiresMasterRead: true } }`), control detail probe185_cline (same, no opt-in), detail probe185_vline (opted in, master vault); one permission set probe185_detail_writer (allowRead only on both masters; read/create/edit, no delete, on the three details). os validate exit 0. Personas made by the dev admin with POST /api/v1/auth/admin/create-user (membershipCreated true, role member) and changed their forced password (POST /api/v1/auth/change-password 200; before that every data call is 403 PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED); A and B granted the set by POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_permission_set; C no set.
